glyph.isekai_mahou.city_erect.desc: City EFFECT. In YOUR city: does AT ONCE a share of the nearest work (1/4 to 2/3 of a day, by Circle), for HALF your max mana. Each work takes at most 3/4 of a day of magic per day — the wait remains, magic only moves it ahead. The city needs a builder and the people cannot be miserable. Arcane: level 18, Circle 3.
glyph.isekai_mahou.city_hasten.desc: City EFFECT. In YOUR city (Lord or council): works in progress near the target go faster for 12 s. Amplify: faster; Extend: longer; Expand: farther; Channel: keeps it up while held. Grows with your level and Circle (up to 4×). Works take days: magic moves them ahead a little, and each work takes at most 3/4 of a day of magic per day. Arcane: level 5.
glyph.isekai_mahou.city_shape.desc: City EFFECT. In YOUR city: instantly levels the EMPTY plot you target. Amplify raises and Dampen lowers the plot (1 block per cast; more at high Circle), up to 4 blocks from the plaza height. Costs 15%% of max mana, +10%% per block. Only on plots already unlocked by the center level. Arcane: level 10, Circle 2.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_free_plot: Building preview: green = allowed, red = not allowed. The arrow shows the entrance.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_how: How about YOUR own city? Buy a Founding Charter from the Scribe in the starting city (or craft one: book and quill, 2 gold ingots and 2 paper). Hold it and right-click the spot: on land, on water (Tab) or in the sky (with a Sky Core).
hint.isekai_mahou.city_looks: Each level now changes the whole building. Older buildings get the new look on their next upgrade, or with "Rebuild in the new look" in the planner.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_magic_build: Building magic: put the Work Surge effect in a spell and cast it near the site — the builders get a little ahead of the day.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_monument: Monument finished! While active it gives its bonus to those the city protects. Sneak and touch it with an empty hand to carry the blessing for a day.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_monument_bless: Blessing: half of the monument's bonus, for one day, outside the city too. One per day — choose well.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_pace: City works take days — and they go on while you are away (sleeping counts). Works shows "day X of Y" and the Diary.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_pace_help: You helped the build! You can hammer a little each day at every site and deliver materials in the Works tab.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_pause: Work paused: it uses no days or materials and its builders move to the others. Resume it any time in the Works tab.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_preview: City hologram: green = good ground, yellow = slope, blue = water, red = you cannot found here.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_reform: Renovation started! Plaza, streets and walls change little by little. For buildings, open the planner and renovate them one by one.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_sky_fall: Falling off the Sky Island won't kill you: the island softens the fall. To get back, look for the stone ring on the ground, under the Updraft.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_sky_found: Your city was born as an archipelago above the clouds! The central island forms first; each plot gets its own island, with a bridge, when you order a building there.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_sky_updraft: Updraft: step into the glowing column to rise to the city. Sneak to float down slowly.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_tier: Your city rose in rank! The builders will renew streets, lamps, plaza and walls little by little — see Overview → Rank.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_trades: Tradesman: the stock belongs to the city and comes back every dawn. Sneak and click for his service (repair, healing, rumor).
hint.isekai_mahou.city_trades_new: A tradesman has arrived! Smithy, Tavern, Library... each building brings its own. See Caravans → Tradesmen.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_water_boat: The arched bridges let your boat pass underneath: you can sail around the city.
hint.isekai_mahou.city_water_found: Your city was born on the water! Every building raises its own platform, linked by a bridge; plots you leave empty stay as water. Boats wait at the quay.
isekai_mahou.configuration.cityPace.tool: Multiplies how many in-game days city works take. 1 = normal; 0.5 = half the time; 2 = twice as long. The server's setting is the one that counts.
item.isekai_mahou.founding_charter.desc: Found YOUR city — on land, on the water or in the sky (with a Sky Core) — in the style and with the name you choose. The builders raise everything on their own. Cheap to craft, or buy it from the Scribe in the starting city.
item.isekai_mahou.founding_charter.use: Hold the Charter to preview the city on the ground. Right-click pins; arrows move, R rotates; right-click again founds.
item.isekai_mahou.oath_seal.desc: Use it on the sworn city's heart to challenge its Champion and become its Lord.
item.isekai_mahou.sky_core.desc: A piece of sky caught in crystal: it holds a whole island in the air.
item.isekai_mahou.sky_core.use: With it and the Founding Charter in your inventory, your city can be born in the sky (Tab in the preview). Spent on founding. The Alchemist in the starting city sells it.
settlements.isekai_mahou.abandoned: You stepped down from %s. The city, buildings and people remain.
settlements.isekai_mahou.bp.cant_cancel: The work already started — it can't be cancelled.
settlements.isekai_mahou.bp.desert.arcan: The all-seeing eye: monsters, intruders and invisible creatures within 24–56 blocks start glowing (level 4+: they lose invisibility). Security.

Protective dome over the territory: hostile magic against those the city protects deals 18–50% less damage (level 1–5); enemy magic projectiles fizzle at the border (52–100%); enemy spells cast inside weaken or dissipate; monsters near the catalyst get shocked and slowed. Uses fuel. The Lord can record a spell on the catalyst (click it): during sieges the Barrier casts its effects on invaders, spending the Core's mana.

settlements.isekai_mahou.bp.desert.barra: +3 guards, unlocks the militia and gives lots of security. During raids, guards and militia fight with Strength and Resistance.

settlements.isekai_mahou.line.builder.am: One more brick, one more dream.
A good blueprint is an approved blueprint.
If it falls, we raise it again. Prettier.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.builder.ta: I'll raise whatever you plan. Without asking for a single stone!
Every new blueprint grows the city. And I love a building site.
More builders, more works at once. Level up the Builders' Hall!
We level the whole plot before building. Stairs only if the hill insists.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.generic.2: This city has seen better days.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.guard.curf: Gates are shut. If you're not from here, move along.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.guard.talk: We protect the Lord, their party and the citizens. Whoever attacks you here deals with me.
With the wall done, I can close the gates at night by decree.
A Castle or a Sphinx would make us much stronger.
At war, nobody from the enemy city trades with us. And I don't allow it either.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.merchant.a: Every trade fills the Lord's treasury.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.merchant.b: One moment, I'm with another customer!
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.merchant.h: I've got just what you need.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.merchant.t: I buy what the land gives and sell what the city needs.
Taxes change my prices. Talk to the Lord!
A busy Market is the sign of a rich city.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.militia.am: I trained all week for this.
Point out the enemy, my Lord.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.militia.ta: We're the city's warriors. We follow the Lord or defend the heart.
Click me if you want to switch orders.
Against an enemy city, we fight to the end.
If we fall behind, we'll find a way to catch up.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.refuse.2: Leave before I call the guards!
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.resident.a: The bread came out warm today.
They say the city's Lord is powerful...
Such a nice view from the plaza.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.resident.d: The shade of the palms is worth gold around here.
The Sun blesses those who build wonders.
Fresh water and a firm wall: that's all we need.
The forge has not gone cold since my grandfather's day.
There's dark ale in the hall tonight.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.resident.e: The forest lends us this place.
Hear that? The leaves are singing today.
We are in no hurry. Neither are the trees.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.resident.g: Lovely night... they all are, around here.
The soul lanterns keep away what comes from the dark.
The bells rang on their own again.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.resident.n: There's mead in the hall tonight.
Our ancestors watch us from the stars.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.resident.o: The cherry trees will bloom early this year.
A hot cup of tea solves almost anything.
Walk through the torii with respect, traveler.
settlements.isekai_mahou.line.resident.t: We came with a bundle on our backs and found a home.
If the people are happy, the city prospers. Festivals help!
Low taxes put everyone in a good mood.
I heard other cities are arming up. I hope it's not against us.

settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.place.free: Sky Island · Right-click: pin here · R: rotate the plaza · Tab: back to the ground
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.place.groun: City preview · Right-click: pin here · R: rotate the plaza · Tab: Sky Island
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.place.pinne: Sky Island · Arrows: move · R: rotate · Right-click: found in the sky · Tab: back to the ground
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.ui.core.mis: You need a Sky Core in your inventory.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.ui.core.rec: How to get it: the Alchemist in the starting city sells it, or craft it with 2 Feathers, 2 Amethyst Shards and 1 Mana Crystal.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.ui.pick.cos: Spends 1 Sky Core, on top of the Founding Charter.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.ui.pick.pre: Close the charter (Esc) to see the island in the preview and move the spot; your choices are kept.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.ui.pick.tip: The city is born as an archipelago high above the clouds: a central island with the Updraft, and one island for each plot, linked by bridges. Works with any style.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.ui.tip.form: Works on plots that have no land yet wait for it to form.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.ui.tip.grow: Go up and down through the Updraft, at the Sky Pier.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.ui.tip.land: The city sits on a floating island, and the island grows with it.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.ui.tip.trai: Trait: the city's people take no fall damage within the island's territory.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.updraft.clo: The gates of %s are closed: the Updraft only carries its own people.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.updraft.no_: The land of %s is still forming: the Updraft has nowhere to land yet.
settlements.isekai_mahou.sky.wait.land: Waiting for the land to form
settlements.isekai_mahou.stash.collected: You took %s items from the storehouse.
No work in the queue. Ask for a blueprint at the city heart!
settlements.isekai_mahou.status.guard.ga: Gates open day and night, by decree.
At night the gates close and outsiders must leave.
Gates shut by decree. No outsiders get in.
settlements.isekai_mahou.status.guard.wa: We're at war with %s. Eyes open!
settlements.isekai_mahou.status.merchant: Low taxes! I can sell cheap.
Taxes are fair. Business is good.
With taxes this high, I have to charge more...
Orders: follow the Lord wherever they go.
settlements.isekai_mahou.status.resident: What a great city to live in! The Lord looks after us.
Life goes on. A festival wouldn't hurt...
Taxes, war... the people are unhappy.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.desert.bo: Bonus: wonders (regeneration in the city, +50% taxes, elite guards). Building is 10% slower.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.desert.de: Simple sandstone walls, terraces and domes — and the WONDERS: Sun Obelisk, Great Pyramid and Guardian Sphinx.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.dwarven.b: Bonus: mines yield double (plus copper), building is 20% faster and guards get +4 armor. Weak point: −25% food, +25% fuel and each rank needs 10% more prosperity.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.dwarven.d: Cut stone with copper bands, copper roofs and forge braziers in the plaza. Built to last a thousand years.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.elven.bon: Bonus: +30% food and half the fuel use. Weak point: each rank needs 25% more prosperity and guards wear no armor.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.elven.des: Pale wood, mossy stone, green roofs overgrown with leaves and soft lights. The city seems to have grown out of the forest.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.gothic.bo: Bonus: guards with +6 armor and +30% security. Weak point: −1 happiness per day and raids bring wither skeletons from Town rank on.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.gothic.de: Dark stone, pointed roofs with iron spires, purple stained glass and soul lanterns. Imposing and very well guarded.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.kingdom.b: Bonus: guards get +4 armor, plus the Castle (elite guards, +10% taxes).
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.kingdom.d: Tall stone wall, timber-framed houses and a Castle at max level. The classic balance.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.nordic.bo: Bonus: builders are 40% faster and every level costs 35% less prosperity.
settlements.isekai_mahou.style.nordic.de: Log palisade, cabins and steep-roofed longhouses. Rustic and quick to raise.
Bonus: +1 happiness per day and +15% taxes. Weak point: building is 15% slower and guards wear light armor (+2).
Curved dark-tile roofs, red timber, paper windows, cherry trees in the plaza and a torii gate on every wall. A city of harmony and trade.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.caravan: A merchant is free: send a caravan.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.center: The center can rise to level %s (Overview).
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.expand: The city can GROW: open another ring under Plan.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.food: Food for only %s day(s): deliver food or build Farms.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.fuel: Fuel for only %s day(s): deliver logs/coal or build a Sawmill.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.housing: Houses are full: build or upgrade homes so the city can grow.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.idle: The builders are idle and there are free plots.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.market: Build a Market to send caravans.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.raid_due: A horde is prowling nearby: ready the defenses.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.repair: %s damaged building(s): repair them under Plan.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.security: Security below what is needed: towers, barracks, walls.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.stash: The storehouse has goods: collect them under Caravans or Overview.
settlements.isekai_mahou.tip.unhappy: People are very unhappy: see the reasons on the left.
settlements.isekai_mahou.track.challenge: Use the Oath Seal on the city heart.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.cmd.head: Tradesmen of %s — deals today: %s · fee today: %s · fee total: %s
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.cmd.row.a: … %s — on the way · shop level %s · %s of %s offers
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.diary.day: Tradesmen: %s deals yesterday, +%s coins of fee in the treasury
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.gain.rare: Tradesmen: +10%% stock and %s new rare items
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.heal.ask: Treatment for %s coins (full health, no bad effects)? Sneak and click again.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.line.arca: I feel a good flow in this city.
The essences change with the days.
May your mana never run dry.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.line.blac: This steel will hold against a dragon.
One more blow and the blade sings.
A worn piece I fix in no time.
What will it be? Blade or tool?
Well forged. Take care of it!
Come back when the blade dulls.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.line.heal: A potion in your pocket is worth two shields.
No fighting on an empty stomach!
Take it easy for a few days.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.line.innk: You hear everything in here, friend.
Have a seat! What will you have?
The pot just came off the fire.
The next round is on you too.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.line.jewe: I can tell good gold from afar.
Every stone has its own light.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.line.lumb: For every tree that falls, I plant two.
This log makes one fine beam.
How many logs will you take?
There is more where that came from.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.line.mech: This runic engine purrs like a cat.
Who left the cart without a crystal again?
A brand new carpet leaves the bay today.
Welcome to the workshop! Mind the spilled mana.
Enjoy it, and easy on the turns!
Come back if it makes a funny noise.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.line.mine: There is a fine vein down there.
You can never have too many torches.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.line.scri: Every great spell starts as a draft.
This page speaks of a faraway place...
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.line.stab: A well-kept beast runs twice as far.
Fresh hay came in this morning.
Bring her by for a rest.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.rumor.0: They say a caravan to a distant city pays much more — but the road is more dangerous.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.rumor.1: The tradesmen restock every dawn. Early birds get the best.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.rumor.2: The Blacksmith told me: with a bigger Smithy he repairs cheaper and reinforces better.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.rumor.3: Happy folk work faster. A festival now and then does wonders for the works.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.rumor.4: Every upgraded building brings more goods to the shop of whoever works in it.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.rumor.5: The rare things only show up when the city ranks up. Town, City, Capital...
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.rumor.6: The Lord takes a share of every sale. A city with busy trade has a full treasury.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.rumor.7: A watchtower lets the scouts warn before a raid. I hear it first, of course.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.rumor.int: Come closer... I heard something at the bar.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.rumor.rai: The scouts were talking: monsters should attack the city in %s day(s). Strengthen the guard.
The scouts came running in: the monster raid is today!
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.service.p: Not enough coins: the service costs %s.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.smith.fin: That piece is already the best I can make it.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.smith.rei: Reinforce %s (Unbreaking %s) for %s coins? Sneak and click again.
To reinforce further, the Smithy needs level %s.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.smith.rep: Repair %s for %s coins? Sneak and click again.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.arca: Mana crystals, mana potions and essences. The elemental essences change every day.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.blac: Iron tools, weapons and armor, made right here. Worn piece? Sneak and click with it in hand: I repair it. If it is whole, I reinforce it so it lasts longer.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.heal: Health potions and remedies for the road. If you come in hurt or poisoned, sneak and click: I will patch you up.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.innk: Hot food and drink for the road. And whoever tends the bar hears everything: sneak and click and I will share a rumor.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.jewe: I buy gold and stones, and sell chipped gems and the chisel. The gems in the window change every day.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.lumb: Logs and planks from our land, always. On good days wood from afar comes in too.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.mech: I sell vehicles — more kinds as the Workshop grows —, upgrade parts and Repair Kits. Sneak and click: I repair the vehicle in your hand or yours parked nearby, rebuild a destroyed one and recover a lost one.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.mine: Stone, coal and whatever the mine gives. The deeper the mine, the better the ore.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.scri: Paper, ink, books and blank scrolls for your recipes. Now and then a lost page turns up here.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.shop: My shop is level %s: %s of %s offers open. Shelves are full again every dawn. Upgrade the building and rank up the city for the rest.
My shop is level %s: all %s of %s offers open. Shelves are full again every dawn.
settlements.isekai_mahou.trade.talk.stab: Saddles, leads, hay and all your mount needs. With a bigger stable I can get armor and reins.
settlements.isekai_mahou.treasury.at_hea: You need to be inside the city to use the treasury.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.abandon.tip: Only you leave power. Buildings, works, population, stock, level and members stay. Power passes to a councillor/citizen (or the city stays ungoverned).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.abdicate.tip: You stop being Lord. The city keeps its stock and people; the next conqueror inherits it.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.aff_max: Max happiness! You can declare war and train the militia.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.center.max: Max level: it is a Capital!
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.center.tip: The city's rank (Camp → Village → Town → City → Capital) caps every building's level and unlocks plots, new buildings, rings and the city's look. Raids get stronger.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.challenge.ti: Needs the Oath Seal. Stay within 48 blocks of the heart: fleeing, dying or going past 6 minutes ends the challenge.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.claim.tip: The city has no ruler: as a citizen you can take over.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.collect.tip: Takes the taxes from the treasury (up to 640) and the storehouse goods, from anywhere inside the city.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.council.hint: Councillors are citizens who can plan the city (build, upgrade, repair, level, renovate the center and hold festivals). Taxes, decrees, war and the treasury stay with you.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.council.none: No citizens yet. Players join as citizens at the city heart.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.declare.tip: Declare war: players in the enemy Lord's guild/party become enemies; their NPCs fight or flee and won't trade with you.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.decree.gates: The gates stay open. No curfew.
At night the portcullis drops and outsiders get 60 s to leave (the guards go after anyone who stays).
Portcullis always shut and an all-day curfew for outsiders.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.decree.no_wa: The gates only work once the wall is built.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.decree.order: The militia follows you (and catches up if left behind).
The militia patrols the city heart.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.decree.tax.0: ×0.75 income, 1 coin per trade, merchants 15% cheaper and +4 affinity per day.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.decree.tax.2: ×1.4 income, 3 coins per trade, merchants 25% pricier and −5 affinity per day.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.barracks: When the horde arrives, guards and militia gain Strength and Resistance (Strength II with Barracks level 3+).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.calm: Camps are quiet: raids only start once the city becomes a Village.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.fire: Firepower: range up to %s blocks, %s damage per volley.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.forecast: Scouts: next raid in about %s day(s).
Scouts: the horde may strike at any moment!
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.guards.t: Guards come from towers, barracks, walls and the castle; militia is trained on the War tab.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.hint: More security = a smaller horde and less damage. The horde only comes with someone from the city nearby, and you are told which side it comes from.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.mage.tip: The Magic Tower fires bolts stronger and farther than the archers.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.no_scout: Without a Watchtower you only find out 2 minutes ahead. Build one so scouts warn you a day in advance.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.towers.t: Archers shoot the horde during raids (range and damage grow with level) and scouts warn you a day ahead.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.traps.ti: Horde monsters passing nearby take damage and are slowed. Never hurts residents or players.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.def.walls.ti: Each finished wall gives lots of security and its 4 corner towers also shoot the horde.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.deliver.tip: Delivers what you have of this item.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.deposit.tip: Delivers all food and fuel in your inventory to the city granary. You can also click the heart with the item in hand.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.diary.none: The Diary is blank. Plan a work and come back tomorrow.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.donate.tip: Donates Guild Coins/emeralds (1) and gold (2) to the treasury: +1 happiness per 16.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.fest.tip: A 2-day party: decorations across the city, fireworks at night, +8 happiness at the start and +4 a day, taxes +30%% and caravans +20%%.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.festival.tip: A 2-day party: decorations across the city, fireworks at night, +8 happiness at the start and +4 a day, taxes +30%% and caravans +20%%.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.happy.fx.con: Content: production %s%%. From 70 the city produces more, builds faster and attracts twice the people.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.happy.fx.hap: Happy: production and taxes %s%%, building +%s%%, double immigration and +1 caravan. Radiant from 90.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.happy.fx.rad: Radiant: production and taxes %s%%, building +%s%%, double immigration and +1 caravan.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.happy.fx.unh: Unhappy: production and taxes drop to %s%%.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.happy.revolt: Happiness below 10: revolt in %s day(s) unless things change!
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.happy.see: Reasons and tips are on the Happiness tab.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.happy.title: Happiness: %s/100
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.join.tip: You will belong to this city (the guards protect you; its wars are yours).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.leave.tip: You will no longer belong to this city.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.looks.redo: Rebuild in the new look (%s coins)
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.looks.redo.t: This building went up before the new level looks. The builders rebuild it at the same level and style. Empty the lot's chests first.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.militia.hint: Click a militiaman to switch orders. They fight in the city's wars.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.mon.bless.re: Today's blessing is available: sneak and touch an active monument with an empty hand.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.mon.damaged: Damaged: repair it to bring the bonus back.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.mon.limit.ti: How many monuments work at once
The others stay dormant: choose which ones count.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.mon.none: No monuments yet. In Planning, build a Statue, an Arch, a temple or a wonder: each takes days and gives a bonus to those the city protects.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.mon.tip.full: No slot: this rank allows %s active. Put another to sleep first.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.mon.tip.lock: Consecrated today: stays active until dawn.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.mon.tip.off: Click to consecrate: the bonus starts right away.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.mon.tip.on: Click to make it dormant (frees the slot for another).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.mon.tip.plan: Only city planners swap the active monuments.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.mon.title: Active monuments: %s of %s
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.need.approva: Rises with spare food, security, leisure buildings, low taxes, festivals, donations and fulfilled requests. Falls with hunger, cold, war, high taxes and lost raids. Never drops more than 10 in a day. Below 10 for 3 days = revolt (with warnings).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.need.flow: +%s made · −%s used per day · lasts %s days
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.need.food.ti: Each resident eats 1 per day (+1 per center level). Farms, gardens, port and granaries produce part of it. ANY food counts (by nutrition): bread, meat, fish, potatoes...
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.need.fuel.ti: Heats homes, fuels forges and lights (Nordic uses +50%). Counts: logs (4), planks (1), coal/charcoal (8), coal block (72), blaze rod (12), dried kelp block (4). Sawmill and mine produce it.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.need.securit: Guards, barracks, towers, wall, guild, smithy, magic tower... against the size of the city. Low security lowers happiness and makes raids worse.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.need_hall: Build the Town Hall to grow past level 3.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.none.text: You don't have a city yet. Found yours with a Founding Charter (paper, emerald blocks, gold blocks and a book and quill) or conquer a kingdom city: reach EXALTED with the kingdom and sneak + click the city heart to swear the Oath.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.none.title: No city
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.oath.kills: Defend: %s/%s monsters slain in the city
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.oath.other: Your current Oath is with %s (swearing this one switches cities).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.oath.pay.tip: Uses Guild Coins or emeralds from your inventory.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.oath.tip: One Oath at a time. Prove your worth to the city.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.oath.vigil: Vigil: %s/%s s crouched by the heart, at night
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.oath.vigil_h: The vigil counts 1 per second crouching within 6 blocks of the heart, at night.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.pace.deliver: Deliver materials from your inventory to move this work ahead (up to 1/4 of it).
Logs, planks, stone, bricks, glass, iron and copper count. You must be in the city.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.pace.hint: Works take days and go on while you are away (sleeping counts). To help: sneak and click the site with an empty hand.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.pace.speed.t: Goes up with the Builders' Hall, sawmill, workshop, a happy city and festivals.
More builders = more works at once; spare builders help a little.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.bonus.t: Monuments and temples: the city's active bonuses and your blessing.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.decrees: Decrees: taxes, gates, militia (and the Council).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.defense: Defense: towers, traps, barracks, raid forecast (and War).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.diary.t: City Diary: what started, what moved on and what was inaugurated.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.happy.t: Happiness: today's reasons, what the city needs, residents' requests and the festival.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.needs.t: Supplies: food, fuel, security, deliveries and People's Requests.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.overvie: Overview: center, happiness, treasury and population.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.plan.ti: Plan: the city map, plot by plot, and expansion.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.tier.ti: The city's rank: what is missing to rise and what each rank unlocks.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.trade.t: Caravans: send merchants to other cities and collect the goods.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.page.works.t: Works: the builders' queue, in days, and the City Diary.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.pause.all.ti: Pauses every work in the queue
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.pause.cancel: Click again to give up on the work
This work can only be paused
Give up on this work (click twice)
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.pause.resume: It carries on from where it stopped.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.pause.tip2: A paused work uses no days or materials, and its builders move to the others. The site stays as it is.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.peace.tip_lo: The other city's Lord must accept (only Lord-less kingdom cities charge %s coins).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.peace.tip_tr: A kingdom city without a Lord accepts peace for %s coins from the treasury.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.blocked: Plot covered by a freely placed building.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.contain: Replace, upgrade or demolish only with the plot's chests/barrels empty.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.damaged: Damaged by a horde: half effects.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.demolis: The building is removed and the plot levelled.
The city is already at its maximum size.
Needs: center level %s · %s/%s plots with a building
Opens another ring of plots (becomes %s×%s). Depends on people, happiness and buildings — no waiting. The catalog grows too: more houses, farms and towers.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.free.ti: Pick a building, then WHERE it goes and which way it faces, with a preview in the world (green = allowed, red = not allowed). The grid is still the quick way.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.hint: Click a plot on the map to choose what to build, upgrade, replace, repair or level. The center (beacon) is the city heart. To put a building off the grid, use "Free position".
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.move.ti: Pick the new spot in the world. The builders demolish here and rebuild there, same level. Paid from the treasury; chests must be empty.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.outside: Outside the city. Use "Expand" (below the map) to open another ring of plots.
The builders put the blocks back. In the Works tab you can pay to finish right away.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.replace: Choose another building for this plot (the current one is demolished).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.style.t: Building style (each plot can have its own style).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.terrafo: New buildings use the levelled height. Plots at different heights get steps in front of the door.
Cuts hills and fills holes on the whole plot (15×15) at the chosen height, with retaining walls on the edges.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.terrain: Steep ground: level it first or the building cuts into the hill.
Water on the plot: the work lays a foundation (or level it).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.upgrade: Capped by the center (level %s). Upgrade the center first.
Free, but it takes days: the building is rebuilt bigger and prettier and its effect grows.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.plan.wall.ti: Wall with towers and 4 gates. Each wall ring gives +10 security; you can have several, one every 2 rings of plots.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.raid.due: A horde prowls the area (it comes when a city member is nearby).
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.raid.now: ⚔ Raid in progress — defend the city!
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.rank.max: Capital: the highest rank. Your city is the pride of the realm!
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.rank.upgrade: Starts the center renovation. When it finishes, the city changes rank and the builders renew streets, lamps, plaza, facades and walls little by little.

settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.reform.tip: Changes the city's style (bonus and weak point, residents, streets, plaza and walls). It is expensive and the work is gradual. Nothing you built by hand is erased; finished buildings keep the old style until you renovate each one.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.reform.title: Style renovation
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.requests.hin: Each fulfilled request: +5 happiness and coins to the treasury. New requests every 3 days.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.rush.tip: Pays %s coins from the treasury for the builders to finish the repair right now.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.shops.fee: Lord's fee: %s%% of sales and services
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.shops.hint: Click a tradesman to trade; sneak and click for his service. Stock belongs to the city and comes back every dawn.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.shops.tip.bu: Build %s (unlocked at rank %s) to bring this tradesman.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.shops.tip.da: Damaged building: serves as level 1 until repaired.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.shops.tip.mo: Upgrade the building: more offers and more stock. Rare items need a higher city rank.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.shops.tip.se: Mana crystals and potions, essences (change daily) and blank scrolls.
Iron tools, weapons and armor. Service: repairs and reinforces the piece in your hand.
Health, healing and resistance potions. Service: full health and no bad effects.
Food, return scrolls and incense. Service: rumors (free).
Chisel and chipped gems (change daily); buys gold and stones.
Logs, planks, charcoal, scaffolding and wood from other lands.
Vehicles (Boat and Cart at level 1; Carpet at 2; Broom and Rover at 3; Airship and Skiff at 4; Galleon at 5), upgrade parts, Repair Kits and Mana Crystals. Services: repair, rebuild, recover.
Stone, coal, iron, copper, redstone, gold and, at City rank, diamond.
Paper, ink, books, blank scrolls and lost pages.
Saddles, leads, hay, horse armor, whistle and reins.

settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.trade.no_des: No known city or village nearby. Go explore!
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.trade.pick: Pick a destination from the list. The merchant travels as a %%, trades there and returns by himself — far pays better, but with more risk of bandits. Several caravans to the same city on the same day flood its market.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.trade.planne: Only the ruler and the council send caravans.
settlements.isekai_mahou.ui.trade.short: Not enough cargo (the city keeps 2 days of stock).

settlements.isekai_mahou.water.found.aim: Aim at the water: a Water City's Heart is born right on top of it.
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.found.ann: %s founded %s (%s), a city upon the waters!
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.found.dry: Not enough water here: only %s%% of the territory is deep water (it takes %s%%). Look for open sea, a big lake or a wide river.
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.found.sta: The plaza rises on stilts. Every building brings its own deck.
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.found.str: A monument or an old structure sits in these waters. Pick another spot.
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.place.fre: Water City · Aim at the water · Right-click: pin here · R: rotate the plaza · Tab: change terrain

settlements.isekai_mahou.water.place.pin: Water City · Arrows: move · R: rotate · Right-click: found on the water · Tab: change terrain
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.ui.pick.c: No extra cost: the cost is finding the spot — deep water under at least 35%% of the territory (sea, bay, big lake or wide river).
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.ui.pick.p: Close the charter (Esc) and aim at the water to see the city in the preview; your choices are kept.
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.ui.pick.t: The city is born on top of the water: a platform for the plaza and one for each plot, on stilts, linked by arched bridges — you can boat between them. Works with any style.
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.ui.tip.ca: A plot with no building stays water. A canal circles every wall: boats wait at the quay, in front of the plaza, and the gate bridges let a boat pass underneath.
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.ui.tip.de: The city stands on the water: every building raises its own deck on stilts, and boardwalks link the plots to the plaza.
settlements.isekai_mahou.water.ui.tip.tr: Trait — Harbor: fishing brings +%s food a day (more as the city ranks up) and its people hold their breath twice as long underwater within the territory.
